title: search-api outage — ranking-service OOM following config push #4471
summary: A configuration push (#4471, 12:58 UTC) raised the ranking cache size 8x, driving ranking-service into an OOM crash loop. /search returned 503s across all regions until the push was rolled back and the previous config pinned.
root_cause: config push #4471 raised ranking cache size 8x; ranking-service OOMKilled in a crash loop
resolution: rolled back config push #4471 and pinned the previous configuration; ranking-service recovered

impact.note: Duration and customer count are the authoritative post-hoc figures, reconciled after recovery from the edge and origin logs. They were not known during the live incident and so do not appear in the response-channel thread.

timeline.event: config push #4471 deployed (ranking cache size raised 8x)
search-api error rate spiked to ~60%; INC-2024-0911 opened
ranking-service pods OOMKilled; crash loop confirmed
service recovered; error rate returned to baseline
